lines.en: Sakaki-bar-a hasn't been very busy as of late. Which means either word hasn't gotten around that the dragon has returned or that Yuki was just never why it was in the first place.
lines.zh: Sakaki 酒吧最近不太忙。这意味着,要么「龙已归来」的风声还没传开,要么 Yuki 从来就不是它红火的原因。

lines.en: She's lost a bit of her edge recently. But it's not as if I'm about to hold that against her on account of her body craving the big sleep instead of one more standard night of bed rest.
lines.zh: 她最近锋芒钝了一些。但我不打算揪着这个不放——毕竟她的身体渴望的是长眠,而不是又一个标准的卧床静养。

lines.en: She has no tables to clean. No cooler to restock. So she stands beside me and the two of us spend the next hour just...doing what we always do.
lines.zh: 她没有桌子要擦。没有冷柜要补货。于是她站在我身旁,接下来的一个小时,我们只是……做着一直做的事。

lines.en: Shooting the shit. Pretendings things aren't nearly as scary as they actually are despite the two of us knowing that we are now and always will be wrong.
lines.zh: 闲扯。假装事情没有实际上那么可怕——尽管我们俩都心知肚明,我们现在错了,而且永远会错下去。

lines.en: People like us never need to be right, though. At least not outwardly. And we're at our best when we keep our truths to ourselves as that keeps everyone else at arm's length from suffering.
lines.zh: 不过像我们这样的人,从不需要正确。至少表面不需要。我们把真相留给自己,便是最佳状态——因为那让其他人与痛苦保持着安全的距离。

lines.en: It feels like just the other day that that was all I could do in here. Suffer. And I never imagined this place being somewhere I could catch my breath.
lines.zh: 感觉就在前几天,我在这里能做的也只有这个。受苦。而我从未想过,这个地方会成为一个让我喘息的所在。

lines.en: Perhaps her lungs are failing so that mine can thrive.
lines.zh: 也许,她的肺在衰竭,好让我的肺蓬勃。

lines.en: I've always wanted to take someone's breath away.
lines.zh: 我一直想夺走某人的呼吸。

lines.en: I'd like to say something about how I stuck around to help her close the store, but it was basically already closed by the time I showed up.
lines.zh: 我很想说一段「我留下来帮她打烊」的美谈,但实际上我到的时候,店基本已经关了。

lines.en: I do stick around, though. Because I have a feeling this bar will still be standing long after she is.
lines.zh: 不过我确实留下来了。因为我有种预感:在她走后很久,这家酒吧还会立在那里。

lines.en: There's something peculiar about it all, though.
If this world truly is infinite...then why am I so scared for her?
lines.zh: 如果这个世界真的无限……那我为什么还在为她害怕?
Yuki 的好感度提升到了 [yuki_love]!
